headline: TRUMP 🧔 CALLS AI ⚠️ SAFETY a Total HOAX 🐂 as He REJECTS 🛑 Guardrail Demands
text:
US Prez 🍊 Donald Trump just went FULL 🦅 SEND on those AI 🤖 safety fears calling them a straight up HOAX 🐂 while trashing 🗑️ any calls 📣 for extra guardrails 🛠️ on this fast moving tech 🧠!! It dropped right after Jack Clark 🧔‍♂️ co founder of Anthropic the AI giant 🏭 told the BBC 📺 a mandatory KILL SWITCH 🔪 that third parties 👥 can check might be needed to keep things from going full SKYNET 🤖!! Clark's take came hot on the heels of fresh warnings ⚠️ from execs and staff at top AI firms about risks to all humanity 🌍 that sparked a brutal selloff 📉 in tech shares as investors freaked 🫨 over possible slowdowns in that multi BILLION 💰 dollar AI race 🏎️!!

In a wild string of social media posts 📱 the US president compared those AI warnings to the Global Warming Scam 🌡️ which he blasted as being pushed by Radical Left Dumocrats 🐴!! Trump crowned himself the HOAX BUSTER 🕵️‍♂️ likening the whole thing to that RUSSIA RUSSIA RUSSIA HOAX 🇷🇺 and insisted the ONLY guardrails 🛤️ AI needs is a strong and smart president like himself 💪!! He dropped another post screaming there is a SICK 🦠 conspiracy against AI and Data Centers 🖥️ with only China 🇨🇳 popping bottles 🍾 happy about it because WHOEVER WINS AI WINS THE WORLD 🌎!! Chinese state media fired back saying experts warned Washington's anxiety 😟 over China's rapid AI growth is twisting its policy priorities big time!!

Xin Qiang a professor at Fudan University told Global Times that they know China has become a strong competitor 🥊 in AI and worry that if the US slows down or tightens rules 📜 then China could catch up even faster like a rocket 🚀!! Meanwhile Jack Clark one of Anthropic's seven founders said earlier Monday that a full shut off method for AI software if it gets too dangerous might need society to eventually pass rules around it 🛡️!! He added most labs including Anthropic already have ways to pull the plug 🔌 but lawmakers might have to enforce having one standard version for real safety!!

UK Business Secretary Jonathan Reynolds jumped in Tuesday saying folks should never be complacent 😶‍🌫️ about AI impacts but also warned not to get hyperbolic 📢 either!! Speaking to the BBC he admitted of course there are risks 🛑 but let's be frank there are tremendous upsides too in public services 🏥 healthcare 💉 and massive economic boosts 💵!! A growing crew of tech industry and political figures are now yelling for better safeguards 🛠️ with Microsoft AI this week dropping docs on limiting models under what they call humanist AI 🤝!!

Microsoft AI chief Mustafa Suleyman told CNBC they had been cooking that new guidance for months and dropped it now because of the raging debate 🔥 around the tech!! In a wild twist two high profile opposites Steve Bannon and Bernie Sanders are both set to speak at the Pro Human Assembly in Washington today pushing a more human centric path for AI development 🧑‍🤝‍🧑!! Sanders told BBC Newsnight last week we gotta do something immediately to stop the uncontrolled growth of AI or face the existential threat of humanity getting wiped out 🌌!! The whole debate exploded again after Jacob Coxon's viral post about leaving Anthropic over fears AI could wipe out humanity entirely 💥!!

Anthropic scientist Evan Hubinger said he thinks the chance of AI causing human extinction within the next decade is more than TEN PERCENT 📈!! Chief exec Dario Amodei called for slowing the pace of AI development and closer monitoring like his company has pushed before even if some question the motives 🤨!! Amodei stressed any reins on AI must happen without sacrificing commercial advantage 💼!! Bosses of rival firms Sam Altman of OpenAI and Elon Musk of xAI both nodded agreement with slowing industry wide plus independent monitoring of all AI models to keep the whole game from going off the rails 🚂!!
